name: Mesh drag (warp a latent by dragging random mesh points)
plain: Picks random points on a coarse mesh over the latent, drags each a random distance, smooths the displacement with B-spline passes and resamples the latent through it. A seeded, local smear that keeps the latent's values but moves them.
math:
Pick P mesh vertices; drag m ~ U(min, max) at angle θ (fixed or random).
Displacement field = smoothed, upsampled vertex drags.
z'(u) = z(u − disp(u)) by grid sampling.

providers.author: ttulttul
providers.note: Not installed here. Read at commit 86d3d20; the README calls the pack a set of perturbation tools, not a sampler.
